persons.name: Siddhimuni
persons.evidence: paramopāsakaśrī3vajradevīcaraṇasevitaśrīvajrācāryasiddhinikasya ... śrīvajrācāryasiddhiminiṃ tha o kuladevatāyā‥ pāṭha yāya, yāta tha manaṃ thva sarvatantracoyā saṃmpūrṇna siddha yānā dina jula

purpose: tha o kuladevatāyā pāṭha yāya yāta (for recitation for one's own tutelary deity) and anuttarajñānaphala for all beings
notes: The name is written first as Siddhinika and then as Siddhimuni (siddhiminiṃ). Mahībhadrācārya is mentioned only in the standing designation of the vihāra (mahibhadrācāryasaṃskārita-maitrīpurī-mahāvihāra).
